title: Senior Data Engineering Analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are looking for an experienced technical software support representative with an analytical, troubleshooting mindset and excellent customer service skills. This position reports to the Manager, Central Services Support and is responsible for proactive monitoring, configuration, troubleshooting, and problem resolution of pharmacy suite of centrally hosted software and services.

The Central Services Support Analyst will handle technical and customer escalations, assist other team members with application troubleshooting, lead complex and high-profile projects, and generally support our customers in the use of pharmacy products and services.

A successful candidate must be able to work in a fast-paced, help-desk services environment. Candidate must be a self-starter, have excellent problem-solving skills, be able to work in a team environment, and be detail oriented and able to work independently with minimal supervision. You will be working with a wide range of software and software development professionals including Developers, Database Administrators, Quality Assurance Staff, Product Specialists, and all levels of management.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Willing to work in 24/7 Rotational shifts with rotational weekly offs
* Monitor, Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application and Data feed issues affecting customers' use of products and services
* Work with engineering teams such as DBA, Dev., and various support teams
* Seek assistance with and escalate issues where necessary
* Share and document knowledge, assist in cross-training staff on areas of specialization
* Effectively prepare for and conduct training sessions
* Be able to work with limited supervision and guidance on standard support tasks
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience
* Skills and Competencies:
  + 3+ years of prior application support experience
  + Knowledge of retail pharmacy terms, procedures and business preferred
  + Basic project management skills
  + Proven excellent customer service skills and attitude
  + Proven ability to troubleshoot technical issues involving software, network, data, and database
  + Proven ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing
  + Proven ability to quickly adapt to changing priorities
  + Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a customer support team
  + Proven ability to coach/train team members
* Technical Competencies:
  + Knowledge of Microsoft Windows
  + Knowledge of Dynatrace, Splunk
  + Knowledge of Snaplogic
  + Knowledge of SSH, SFTP
  + Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, Outlook
  + Basic Unix knowledge
  + Basic knowledge of hardware and networks
  + Basic SQL and database knowledge (Oracle)
  + Familiar with Business Intelligence - Data warehouse - Looker, Snowflake

**Preferred Qualification:**

* Knowledge of Software / help desk support

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Assistant Vice President (AVP)
description:
**Responsibilities**

**1. Sales Leadership & Revenue Generation**

● Develop and execute project-wise sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly and

annual sales targets.

● Drive sales closures and revenue growth across all company projects.

● Monitor booking trends, inventory movement and conversion ratios.

● Review sales pipelines and ensure achievement of business objectives.

● Participate in key customer meetings and high-value negotiations.

**2. Telesales & Lead Management**

● Lead and manage the entire Telesales/Telecalling Department.

● Ensure prompt follow-up of all leads generated through digital marketing, references,

walk-ins, channel partners and campaigns.

● Establish lead allocation processes and monitor lead response times.

● Track daily calling activities, appointments fixed, site visits scheduled and conversion

ratios.

● Develop telesales scripts and communication standards.

● Conduct daily reviews of telecaller productivity and lead quality.

● Ensure all leads are accurately updated in CRM.

● Coordinate with the Marketing Department to improve lead quality and conversion.

● Analyze source-wise lead performance and recommend improvements.

● Implement lead nurturing strategies for long-pending prospects.

● Set KPIs for telecallers and telesales managers.

● Ensure no lead leakage and maintain strict lead management discipline.

Telesales KPIs

● Calls Made Per Day

● Lead Contact Ratio

● Appointment Fixing Ratio

● Site Visit Conversion Ratio

● Booking Conversion Ratio

● Cost Per Booking

● Lead Response Time

● CRM Update Compliance

**3. Team Management & Performance Monitoring**

● Lead Sales Managers, Team Leaders, Telecallers, BDOs and Sales Executives.

● Conduct daily, weekly, and monthly performance reviews.

● Develop sales incentive structures and performance improvement plans.

● Identify training requirements and organize coaching sessions.

● Build a high-performance sales culture focused on accountability and results.

**4. Collection Management**

● Work closely with CRM and Finance teams to ensure timely collection of customer

payments.

● Monitor outstanding dues and collection performance.

● Review collection reports and take corrective actions.

● Support collection drives and customer engagement initiatives.

**5. Customer Relationship Management**

● Ensure superior customer experience throughout the sales journey.

● Handle escalated customer concerns and critical negotiations.

● Maintain relationships with key investors, HNIs, brokers and channel partners.

● Improve customer retention and referral business.

**6. Sales Operations & Reporting**

● Review daily sales dashboards and project performance.

● Maintain accurate sales forecasts and revenue projections.

● Present weekly and monthly reports to VP and MD.

● Monitor CRM compliance across teams.

● Analyze funnel performance from lead generation to booking.

**7. Market Research & Competitor Analysis**

● Conduct regular competitor studies on pricing, offers, payment plans and project

positioning.

● Monitor market trends and customer preferences.

● Recommend strategic improvements to sales and marketing initiatives.

**8. Interdepartmental Coordination**

● Coordinate with Marketing for campaigns and lead generation activities.

● Work with CRM for customer onboarding and collections.

● Coordinate with Legal, Projects, and Finance teams for smooth transaction

completion.

● Ensure timely communication regarding project updates and inventory availability.

**Experience**

● 10–15+ years in Sales and Business Development.

● Minimum 5 years in a senior leadership role within Real Estate.

● Proven experience in managing both Field Sales and Telesales Teams.

title: Admission Counsellor
description:
Job Summary

The Admission Counsellor is responsible for managing the student admission process, counselling parents regarding the school's academic programmes and facilities, and ensuring a smooth and positive admission experience. The candidate should possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, a professional approach, and the ability to build strong relationships with parents while promoting the school's values and educational standards.

Key Responsibilities

* **Admission Enquiries and Counselling**
* Handle telephone calls, walk-in enquiries, online enquiries, and admission-related communications.
* Counsel parents about the school's curriculum, CBSE guidelines, academic programmes, facilities, fee structure, and extracurricular activities.
* Explain admission eligibility, age criteria, documentation requirements, and the admission procedure.
* Conduct school campus tours for prospective parents and students.
* **Admission Process Management**
* Manage admission enquiries from initial contact through application, document verification, and enrolment.
* Assist parents with application forms and ensure the submission of required documents.
* Maintain accurate records of enquiries, applications, admissions, and follow-ups.
* Coordinate with the Principal, teachers, accounts department, and administration team during the admission process.
* **Parent Relationship Management**
* Follow up with prospective parents through calls, emails, and messages.
* Address parents' queries professionally and provide timely information.
* Build trust and maintain positive relationships with existing and prospective parents.
* Handle admission-related concerns and escalate complex issues to the appropriate authority.
* **Data Management and Reporting**
* Maintain admission registers, enquiry databases, and student admission records.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly admission reports.
* Track enquiry conversions and follow-up activities.
* Ensure confidentiality and accuracy of student and parent information.
* **Admission Promotion and Outreach**
* Support school admission campaigns, open houses, orientation programmes, and promotional events.
* Coordinate with the marketing team for digital and offline admission activities.
* Assist in developing admission-related communication materials and presentations.
* Contribute to achieving the school's annual admission targets ethically and professionally.
* **Administrative Coordination**
* Ensure that admission procedures are followed in accordance with school policies and applicable CBSE requirements.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure a smooth onboarding process for newly admitted students.
* Perform other admission-related responsibilities assigned by the school management.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; a degree in Education, Psychology, Business Administration, or Communication is preferred.
* Prior experience in school admissions, educational counselling.
* Familiarity with the CBSE school system and school admission procedures is an advantage.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of the local language is preferred.
* Basic computer proficiency, including MS Office, email, spreadsheets, and admission management software.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Front Office Executive (Receptionist)
description:
Roles and Responsibilities – Front Office Executive

**1. Guest Handling & Customer Service**

* Welcome guests warmly and provide professional, courteous service.
* Handle guest enquiries, requests, complaints, and feedback promptly.
* Ensure a smooth and pleasant guest experience throughout the stay.

**2. Check-in and Check-out**

* Perform guest check-in and check-out procedures efficiently.
* Verify guest identification, reservations, and registration details.
* Allocate rooms according to availability and reservation requirements.
* Explain hotel facilities, services, policies, and timings to guests.

**3. Reservations & Room Management**

* Handle walk-in guests, telephone enquiries, and reservation requests.
* Coordinate room allocation, room changes, extensions, and special requests.
* Monitor room availability and update the Property Management System (PMS) accurately.
* Coordinate with Housekeeping regarding room status, readiness, and discrepancies.

**4. Billing & Cashiering**

* Prepare and settle guest bills accurately.
* Handle cash, card payments, and authorised payment methods.
* Maintain accurate records of transactions, advances, refunds, and outstanding balances.
* Ensure proper posting of room charges and other services to guest accounts.

**5. Telephone & Communication**

* Answer telephone calls professionally and transfer calls to the appropriate departments.
* Maintain accurate messages and ensure timely communication.
* Handle guest enquiries through telephone, email, and other approved communication channels.

**6. Coordination with Other Departments**

* Coordinate with Housekeeping for room readiness, cleaning, and maintenance issues.
* Liaise with Food & Beverage, Security, Maintenance, and other departments to fulfil guest requests.
* Inform the Front Office Manager or Duty Manager about operational issues and VIP arrivals.

**7. Records & Documentation**

* Maintain guest registration cards, arrival and departure reports, and other required records.
* Ensure accurate guest information and confidentiality of personal data.
* Complete shift handover reports and maintain proper documentation.
* Follow applicable statutory requirements for guest registration and foreign guest reporting.

**8. Upselling & Revenue Support**

* Promote room upgrades, hotel facilities, dining options, and other available services.
* Provide accurate information about room rates, packages, and promotional offers.
* Support occupancy, revenue, and guest satisfaction targets.

**9. Safety, Security & Compliance**

* Follow hotel SOPs, grooming standards, and service quality requirements.
* Protect guest belongings, room keys, access credentials, and confidential information.
* Report suspicious activities, emergencies, lost property, and safety concerns to the appropriate authority.
* Follow emergency procedures and applicable hotel policies.

**10. Additional Responsibilities**

* Attend departmental briefings, training sessions, and shift handovers.
* Maintain a clean, organised, and professional front desk.
* Perform other duties assigned by the Front Office Manager or management in accordance with hotel operations.
